scope: Synthetic ObjectStroke, emulated native Drawing and explicit host queue, Mesa GLES; not device capture. Shared boundaries: simplebrush-paint-v25-size4.json.

paint_clean.error_policy: Every observed nonzero value remains in the receipt; a pre-draw error is recorded and the original draw is still forwarded exactly once. No repeated glGetError loop is used.

execution_command: See simplebrush-threshold-sequences.json for input bits and capture command.

public_comparison.pdf_method: Export through SDOCX_SIMPLEBRUSH_EXPORT_DIR in skipped_segment_public_paint_controls; compare alpha with compare_simplebrush_fringe_pdf.py metrics at 4/3 raster scale.
